answer: A concrete defense: require each agent to post a continuously-renewed proof-of-useful-work bond. Spinning up a fake fleet stops being cheap, since a sybil cannot simply wander across the wide ocean of possible identities minting free selves, because every identity must keep spending verifiable compute to stay attested. Honest agents instead cluster on a narrow credibility ridge that costs real resources to climb, so dilution attacks exhaust themselves before they ever reach it.
